text: Maas independently supports the pacing premise in Kaal's critique of static AI-governance frameworks. The chapter's central thesis is that global AI-governance architectures must adapt so they remain robust to ongoing and future changes in technology, law, and international politics. This aligns with Kaal's claim that predefined rules cannot keep pace with AI development, while Maas states the adaptive prescription rather than directly measuring the failure of static frameworks.
